metaDescription: Order custom Tran shot glasses in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Perfect for events, bars, and promotions. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Tran offers a diverse selection of shot glasses, from clear glass and frosted finish options to durable plastic and unique shapes like the Mini Moscow Mule. Whether you need a classic 1.5 oz glass for a bar promotion or a colorful plastic shot for a large event, Tran's quality and variety make them a reliable supplier for bulk custom orders. Decorate with screen printing, full-color digital, or etching to match your brand.
heroAltText: Custom Tran shot glasses in clear glass and plastic with printed logos, perfect for promotional events and bars.
